mqtt_port.name: MQTT port
mqtt_port.description: Usually 1883 (normal MQTT) or 8883 (normal MQTT with SSL).

mqtt_user.name: MQTT username
mqtt_user.description: Required when your MQTT broker requires authentication.

mqtt_pass.name: MQTT password
mqtt_pass.description: Required when your MQTT broker requires authentication.

mqtt_ssl_enabled.name: MQTT SSL
mqtt_ssl_enabled.description: If enabled will encrypt communications with the MQTT host.

mqtt_ssl_insecure.name: Skip MQTT SSL validation
mqtt_ssl_insecure.description: If enabled will skip SSL validation, use only for testing.

mqtt_ssl_certfile.name: MQTT Certificate File
mqtt_ssl_certfile.description:
A file containing a certificate, including its chain. Place this file in the Home Assistant `ssl` folder.
Option ignored if SSL is disabled or SSL validation is skipped.

mqtt_ssl_keyfile.name: MQTT Private Key File
mqtt_ssl_keyfile.description:
A file containing the private key. Place this file in the Home Assistant `ssl` folder.
Option ignored if SSL is disabled or SSL validation is skipped.

mqtt_base_topic.name: MQTT base topic
mqtt_base_topic.description: Root topic for this app. For example, "{base_topic}/send_text/set" is used to send bot messages.

mqtt_republish_interval.name: MQTT republish interval
mqtt_republish_interval.description: Republish interval for exposed sensors, e.g. "{base_topic}/running/available".

telegram_api_token.name: Telegram API token
telegram_api_token.description: Create a bot with @BotFather using /newbot, then paste the token returned by BotFather here.

telegram_api_url.name: Telegram API URL
telegram_api_url.description: The "{token}" placeholder will be replaced with the given API token.

telegram_chat_id.name: Telegram chat ID
telegram_chat_id.description: Use @userinfobot and send /start to get your numeric chat ID.

telegram_message_prefix.name: Telegram messages prefix
telegram_message_prefix.description: Prefix added to all the messages sent by the bot, for testing purposes.

telegram_message_start.name: Telegram greeting message
telegram_message_start.description:
Message sent by the bot when the app starts (default: "👌 *telegram2mqtt* started").
Icon from https://apps.timwhitlock.info/emoji/tables/unicode.

telegram_message_stop.name: Telegram goodbye message
telegram_message_stop.description:
Message sent by the bot when the app stops (default: "💀 *telegram2mqtt* stopped").
Icon from https://apps.timwhitlock.info/emoji/tables/unicode.

debug.name: Debug logs
debug.description: Enables the logging of DEBUG-level messages.
